questions.q: Which item is NOT found in a packet header?
questions.why: The data is in the payload. The header holds destination address, packet number and originator's address.

questions.q: Even parity is used with the 7-bit code 1101001. What is the parity bit?
questions.why: 1101001 has four 1s, which is already even, so the parity bit is 0.

questions.q: Which type of data transmission sends data in both directions, but only one direction at a time?
questions.why: Half-duplex is both directions but not at the same time (e.g. a walkie-talkie).

questions.q: Describe how a checksum is used to check that data has been sent correctly.
questions.model: The sender uses an algorithm to calculate a checksum from the data and sends it with the data. The receiver recalculates it from the data received and compares. If the two values differ, an error has occurred and the data is resent.
points: sender calculates checksum from data using an algorithm and sends it with the data
if different, error detected / data resent
